_comment: Ground truth for tooling boundaries, maintained by people; eo_tooling_audit reads but never rewrites it.
ecosystem.json remains the authority for repositories and footings. These entries classify available contributions, not additional projects or membership decisions.

Foundation repositories such as cvc5 are included as tooling providers. Path and coverage findings describe our inventory; they impose no policy obligations on those repositories. Outsiders remain outside this audit.

repo names the containing repository. Optional owner names a child project in that repository; it defaults to repo. path and also list implementation or artifact directories relative to repo, within the owner's root.

kind defaults to tool for general programs and importable libraries. solver identifies constraint-solving programs or libraries; checker identifies proof-checking programs or libraries; webpage identifies sites such as GitHub Pages. These kinds need entrypoints: command launchers, public library modules or site generators.

database identifies maintained records such as bug databases; artifact identifies other maintained data such as proof signatures; tutorial identifies instructional guides. These kinds need content files rather than code entrypoints. Every kind needs docs and is counted separately.

The audit displays two tables: Tools for tool, solver and checker; Artifacts for webpage, database, artifact and tutorial. Webpage artifacts record their generators as entrypoints. Explicit exclusions appear separately after the tables as non-compliant inventory coverage.

entrypoints, files and docs are file paths relative to repo, including shared launchers and docs outside the owner. They are inspected, never executed. Empty required lists are allowed and reported as gaps.
layout_note explains a departure from one self-contained top-level directory within the owning repository or child project. Such departures are advisory, never policy failures.

Documentation is supporting metadata, never a tooling entry. An owner's reserved docs/ and contrib/ directories, including their subdirectories, cannot be path or also entries. contrib/ holds scripts and instructions for manually obtaining external tools.

exclude is keyed by repository or child owner and maps directories relative to that owner's root to reasons. Each explicit exclusion is displayed and counts as non-compliant inventory coverage, not a silent waiver. Reserved docs, scripts, test, tests, examples, cmake, include, licenses, contrib, prompts, deps, scratch, tools and hidden directories are not discovery candidates; see docs/policy.md's layout table.

Discovery considers tracked top-level directories in repositories and child owners named here. Other nested tools and implementations in shared directories need explicit entries. Research charters alone are not tooling.

Initial inventory read from local working trees on 2026-09-19: anoieu 06bd787, dokimasia 158c385, epikrisis e748ff6, ethos 21fc6c7d, eudaimonia 79dd601, kanon f22798f, koine 74ea664, logos e8fa2441, paideia 7b305f1, tachyon cccb1b2; iogos has staged files but no first commit. Local changes may be present.

cvc5's entries were read from its clean checkout at a07d513075 on 2026-09-19. Logos's installer was read at e8fa2441; it regenerates from a supplied or cached signature and does not automatically track the latest cvc5.
Paideia's bootcamp tutorial was rechecked at 8240ce9 on 2026-09-19; its source-baseline page records the cvc5 revision and validation limits of the tutorial itself.

Eunoia's tooling was rechecked at 8cfb3ac on 2026-09-19: the formatter lives in eo_format/ with its docstring and CLI help, and mimesis's four tutorials live in tutorials/. Documentation-only outputs, including sapheneia's account, are outside the inventory.

Ethos's tooling was rechecked at a3f1c3af on 2026-09-19. plugins/ contains the plugin collection for compilation and code generation. contrib/ and tests/smtlib/ are reserved project support directories.

Iogos was rechecked at e716d73 on 2026-09-19. Cpc/ contains the generated checker and obligations, with its handwritten soundness scaffold under Cpc/Soundness/. Install and build wrappers live in scripts/. The soundness theory is still a placeholder, not a completed proof.

Epikrisis's site was rechecked at 2dc4125 on 2026-09-19 and lives in ecosystem_report/. Eudaimonia's generator lives in new_checker/ at 50532e0; its staged Euthyna changes separate measurement/ and report_site/, with a shared scripts/ launcher and saved data under measurement/data/. The Euthyna entries describe that working tree, not the committed default branch.

Tachyon's child webpages were read at effe42c on 2026-09-19. Heuresis's report builds gap measurements and a research queue; elaphros's report builds planning and source-evidence pages without measured performance claims. Each builder and its HTML templates live at the child's root and read ledger/ evidence. scripts/build_site.py assembles the site described in docs/site.md.

Metagraphe's rewrite database was read at 258102d on 2026-09-19. rewrite_db/ holds the curated records and their generated view; its validation, rendering and pinned-koine wrappers live in the child's shared scripts/. The records are rewrite proposals and source observations, not established solver fixes.

The audit compares paths and coverage with current local trees or GitHub default branches. Descriptions and tool boundaries remain human readings; presence does not establish correctness or installation.
